rows.en: <on()><sp(20)>October 054<ab(0)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>2nd Defense Platoon in position.<ab(0)><off()>

rows.jp:
<on()><sp(20)>他の連中は連日の訓練で
へばっているからな。<ab(0)>
rows.en:
<on()><sp(20)>The others are exhausted
from non-stop training.<ab(0)>
<sp(20)>It helps that you're so skilled.<ab(0)><off()>

rows.jp:
<on()><sp(20)>…いえ。戦時中ですから…
兵員が足りない以上、当然の仕事です。<ab(0)><off()>
rows.en:
<on()><sp(20)>...Not at all. We are at war...
We're short-handed, so it's my duty.<ab(0)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Enemy attack! It's the Jovian Lizards!<ab(0)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Impossible! They're here?!<ab(0)><off()>

rows.jp:
<on()><sp(20)>カーソン！　無理をせずに下がれ！
新米を死なせるわけにはいかん！<ab(0)><off()>
rows.en:
<on()><sp(20)>Carson! Don't push it, fall back!
I can't let a rookie get killed!<ab(0)><off()>

rows.jp:
<on()><sp(20)>実戦に出た以上、私は兵士です…！
任務を果たします！<ab(0)><off()>
rows.en:
<on()><sp(20)>On the battlefield, I'm a soldier...!
I'll carry out my mission!<ab(0)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Aaargh!<ab(0)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>There are too many of them...!<ab(0)><off()>

rows.jp: <on()><sp(20)>う…遅くなりました！　援軍です！<ab(0)><off()>
rows.en:
<on()><sp(20)>Ugh... Sorry we're late!
Reinforcements are here!<ab(0)><off()>

rows.jp: <on()><sp(20)>…ケプフォード！　お前たち、何やってる！<ab(0)><off()>
rows.en:
<on()><sp(20)>...Kepford!
What do you think you're doing?!<ab(0)><off()>

rows.jp:
<on()><sp(20)>手が足りないんでしょう？
自分たちにも戦わせてください！<ab(0)><off()>
rows.en:
<on()><sp(20)>You're short-handed, right?
Let us fight too!<ab(0)><off()>

rows.jp:
<on()><sp(20)>その機体は修理中だろうが！
ろくに動かんぞ！<ab(0)><off()>
rows.en:
<on()><sp(20)>That unit is under repair!
It'll barely even move!<ab(0)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>We can manage somehow!<ab(0)><off()>

rows.jp: <on()><sp(20)>仲間の窮地を黙って見てられませんよ！<ab(0)><off()>
rows.en:
<on()><sp(20)>I can't just stand by and watch
our comrades in danger!<ab(0)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>All right! Give it all you've got!<ab(0)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Roger that!<ab(0)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>...I'm glad you're safe.<ab(0)><off()>

rows.jp:
<on()><sp(20)>…
タックと言ったわよね…少し…見直した。<ab(0)><off()>
rows.en:
<on()><sp(20)>...Your name was Tak, right?
I think... a little better of you now.<ab(0)><off()>
